result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide multi-lane roadway passing under a large steel bridge structure with minimal dedicated infrastructure. There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, and the narrow sidewalk lacks a buffer from traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible at this wide intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without guidance or protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the roadway.

hazards.name: Poor Visibility Under Bridge
hazards.description: Deep shadows and bridge supports create visual obstructions and reduce the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Area directly under the bridge structure.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is narrow and directly adjacent to travel lanes with no physical barrier or buffer zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add dedicated lighting under the bridge to improve visibility of the sidewalk and crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The environment is a large paved area beneath a highway overpass, explicitly marked with 'No Pedestrian' signage. It lacks any dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, crosswalks, or signals, making it highly hostile to non-motorized travel.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks or marked crossings in a high-capacity roadway environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground and midground area

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large bridge piers and support structures create significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and background where columns meet the ground

hazards.name: Prohibitive Environment
hazards.description: Explicit 'No Pedestrians' signage indicates the area is designed exclusively for motor vehicles and is unsafe for walking.
hazards.location_in_image: Signage in the center of the image

interventions.title: Grade-Separated Pedestrian Facility
interventions.description: Provide a dedicated, protected walkway or bridge if pedestrian connectivity is required through this corridor.

interventions.title: Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Install high-intensity under-bridge lighting to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility for all users.

interventions.title: Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Install fencing or guardrails to prevent pedestrians from entering high-speed traffic lanes from the median area.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed roadway environment underneath a bridge overpass that is entirely devoid of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, crosswalks, or safety barriers, creating a hostile environment for anyone not in a vehicle.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian facilities
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or designated walking areas, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the roadway or on a narrow, unprotected shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right edges of the roadway

hazards.name: Poor visibility under overpass
hazards.description: The deep shadows created by the bridge structure create a high-contrast environment that can obscure pedestrians from drivers entering the underpass.
hazards.location_in_image: Center area under the bridge structure

hazards.name: High-speed roadway geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and merging traffic patterns suggest a high-speed environment with no physical protection for non-motorized users.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes

interventions.title: Construct a protected sidewalk
interventions.description: Install a raised, barrier-protected sidewalk to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians separated from high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Enhance under-bridge lighting
interventions.description: Install improved LED lighting under the overpass to increase visibility and eliminate dark spots for all road users.

interventions.title: Lane narrowing and traffic calming
interventions.description: Reduce lane widths to encourage lower vehicle speeds and provide space for pedestrian or bicycle infrastructure.

result.summary: The environment is a high-speed, multi-lane roadway located directly beneath a massive highway overpass, creating a hostile and dark space for pedestrians. There is a complete lack of visible pedestrian infrastructure, such as crosswalks or sidewalks, and the area is further restricted by temporary metal fencing.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are provided for crossing a wide, multi-lane thoroughfare.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Restricted Pedestrian Access
hazards.description: Metal crowd-control fencing blocks access to paved areas, forcing any pedestrians into the active roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right and center background behind the roadway

hazards.name: Poor Visibility and Shadows
hazards.description: The bridge structure creates deep shadows and the large support pillars obstruct sightlines between drivers and potential pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Under the overpass structure

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Marked crossings with pedestrian-actuated signals are necessary to provide a safe path across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Construct Permanent Sidewalks
interventions.description: Replace temporary fencing with permanent, ADA-compliant sidewalks that are physically separated from traffic.

interventions.title: Under-Bridge Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian-scale lighting under the overpass to improve visibility and personal security.
